class.name: GFNetworkContractAudit
class.description: GFNetworkContractAudit: 网络契约编辑器审计器。 对 GFNetworkContract 执行 fail-closed 倾向的结构审计，帮助项目在运行前发现 松散 payload、未知通道、缺少版本和过宽 Variant 字段等风险。

member.name: audit_contract
member.signature: func audit_contract(contract: GFNetworkContract, options: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:

tags.tag: options: 审计选项，支持 known_channel_ids、require_contract_id、require_version、require_channel_ids、warn_variant_fields、warn_unbounded_collections、max_messages 和 max_fields_per_message。
return: Dictionary with ok, issues, issue_count, summary, and next_action.

member.name: audit_paths
member.signature: func audit_paths(contract_paths: PackedStringArray, options: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
member.description: 审计多个网络契约资源路径。

tags.tag: contract_paths: 契约资源路径列表。
return: Dictionary with ok, issues, issue_count, contract_count, summary, and next_action.
